info.name: Swish Analytics Sportsbook ATP Tennis MLB API

params.name: parlay
params.description: Specifies if this is a bet request for an accumulator (true) or a single market (false)

params.name: margin
params.description: Specifies the margin you would like applied to the returned market. Margin must be a value from 0 to 1 & accepts up to 3 decimal places

params.name: marketAdj
params.description: Specifies if this is a request for markets using our market adjusted (true) or non-market adjusted (false) lines

params.name: sport
params.description: Provides the appropriate 3-letter abbreviation of the sport for which you are requesting data

params.name: playerId
params.description: The ID value(s) of the player(s) for which you are requesting data.

params.name: gameId
params.description: The ID value(s) of the event(s) for which you are requesting schedule data.

params.name: statTypeId
params.description: The ID value of the stat-type for which you are requesting a market. This property accepts a single value per object

params.name: line
params.description: The specific line value for which you are requesting pricing. This property accepts a single value per object

params.name: lineType
params.description: Can be used to request only fractional lines or integer lines.
